on_game_start = {
	on_actions = { aawc_alternate_world_game_start }
}

# AAWC-owned replacement for the useful More Game Rules alternate-world
# startup boundary. Unrelated MGR systems are intentionally not dispatched.
aawc_alternate_world_game_start = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			# AAWC world modes historically ran through MGR's enabled,
			# count-shattered, tribal-holdings setup. Treat every AAWC mode as
			# that same effective prerequisite without adding or moving a
			# dispatcher phase. Other retained MGR choices remain available
			# only when no AAWC world-mode contract is present.
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_game_rule = aawc_alt_world_enabled
					aawc_world_mode_requires_tribal_counties = yes
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_cultures_random_historical }
				aawc_aw_random_culture_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_cultures_chaotic_historical }
				aawc_aw_chaotic_culture_effect = yes
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_faiths_random_historical }
				aawc_aw_random_faith_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_faiths_chaotic_historical }
				aawc_aw_chaotic_faith_effect = yes
			}

			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_dejure_default } }
				aawc_aw_random_map_setup_effect = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_development_default } }
				aawc_aw_development_effect = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_no_shattered_realms }
						aawc_world_mode_requires_tribal_counties = yes
					}
				}
				aawc_aw_shattered_realms_effect = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_yes_random_rulers }
				aawc_aw_randomize_rulers = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_default_holdings }
						aawc_world_mode_requires_tribal_counties = yes
					}
				}
				aawc_aw_holdings_effect = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_game_rule = aawc_aw_baronies_default } }
				aawc_aw_barony_effect = yes
			}
		}

		aawc_aw_clear_vars = yes
	}
}
